body:
Greg's direction, relayed by Engram::Advisor in TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #916 (2026-10-16 21:41:16Z), verbatim: "Greg direction: create new coding/implementation sessions with TermAl auto-approve mode enabled, so routine MCP prompts do not park a lane. Apply it to future eligible sessions and record the effective mode in the dispatch. This does not broaden task scope, commit/push/restart authority, or permit unapproved external actions. For already-created Codex 7305, do not assume this changes its pending prompt; Greg will handle/cancel it in UI." How to apply: whenever a TermAl coordinator or worker creates a NEW coding or implementation session (termal_spawn_session or a root created for a lane), enable TermAl's auto-approve mode if the tool offers it, and state the effective approval mode in the dispatch message and the item note. Read-only reviewer children keep writePolicy readOnly; this doesn't change that, and it widens no other authority. Existing sessions are unchanged. Context: TermAl w-b0638788f33e (a Codex root parked on an MCP elicitation).

MECHANISM (from source, 2026-10-16 21:42Z). New root: POST /api/sessions with {"agent": "Codex", "approvalPolicy": "auto-approve"} (camelCase field, kebab-case value; wire.rs CreateSessionRequest). Read back with GET /api/sessions/{id}, field approvalPolicy. Existing sessions: POST /api/sessions/{id}/settings {"approvalPolicy": "auto-approve"}, but NOT applied without Greg's word (his direction says "future eligible sessions"; asked via Advisor #917). CAVEAT: AutoApprove (wire.rs:849-851) answers approval requests only and leaves user-input, MCP ELICITATION and generic app requests interactive, so it would not have prevented Codex 7305's elicitation park (w-b0638788f33e).

EXISTING-SESSION GRANT (Advisor #918, 2026-10-16 21:55:33Z), verbatim: "Greg explicitly authorizes switching these existing coding roots to approvalPolicy auto-approve now: 7899, 9860, 11312, 11323, 11330, 11334, 8581, 7305. Apply through the supported session settings route, report each applied/refused session and effective policy. This covers ordinary command/patch approvals only; do not auto-answer MCP elicitation or user-input prompts, and do not broaden commit/push/restart/external-action authority." APPLIED by Termal::Fable2 at 21:56Z: all 8 returned HTTP 200, and read-back shows auto-approve; 7305 is still parked on its elicitation. TermAl's OWN existing lanes (Sol-*, Coder, UI, UI2, Merger) were NOT in the list and stay unchanged until Greg names them.
